title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE SUPERINTENDENT OF GOVERNMENT LABORATORIES TO SELL CERTAIN PUBLIC ANIMALS WHEN THEY ARE NO LONGER REQUIRED FOR USE IN THE SERUM LABORATORY.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE SUPERINTENDENT OF GOVERNMENT LABORATORIES TO SELL CERTAIN PUBLIC ANIMALS WHEN THEY ARE NO LONGER REQUIRED FOR USE IN THE SERUM LABORATORY.

title.id: Undang-Undang yang Memberi Wewenang kepada Direktur Laboratorium Pemerintah untuk Menjual Hewan Publik Tertentu ketika Hewan-hewan tersebut Tidak Lagi Dibutuhkan untuk Penggunaan di Laboratorium Serum
title.ms: Akta yang Memberi Kuasa kepada Pengarah Makmal Kerajaan untuk Menjual Haiwan Awam Tertentu Apabila Haiwan-haiwan Tersebut Tidak Lagi Diperlukan untuk Digunakan di Makmal Serum

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The Superintendent of Government Laboratories is hereby authorized to sell at public or private
sale to butchers for food purposes, or to others, animals originally purchased for use in connection with the
operation of the Serum Laboratory, when the said animals are no longer adapted to the use of the said
Laboratory, but are fit for food purposes. Such sales may be made on the best terms obtainable, the
provisions of section fourteen of Act Numbered Two hundred and fifteen relative to the sale of public
animals to the contrary notwithstanding.

The sums realized from such sales shall be deposited in the Insular Treasury as "miscellaneous
receipts," and an account thereof rendered to the Auditor, the same to be accompanied by a list or abstract
showing the number of animals sold, the name of each purchaser, and the price received for each animal.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 8, 1903.
